preconditions.description: The size of the set n must be between 5 and 10000, and b must be at least n and at most 10000.
The size of the set n must be divisible by 5.
The number of hints q must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= upToi <= b and 0 <= quantityi <= n for upToi, quantityi in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint must have an upToi between 1 and b and a quantityi between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: If there exists at least one set satisfying all conditions and matching all hints, output 'fair'.
If no set satisfies all conditions and matches all hints, output 'unfair'.
